lead.what: The 2024 date sets midnight in Baghdad as the last hour for the remaining 2,500 US troops. The call is 0.57 they are off Iraqi territory by 21:00 UTC; Tinkerton puts it at 0.38.

rest.what: Whether Alito is listed as sitting for Suncor when argument begins 5 October stays open at 0.78.

lead.what: Counter-terror police recovered a quantity of petrol from three vans near RAF Fairford and found no explosive devices.
The motor maker filed its year-to-March-2026 report with a disclaimer of opinion and a ¥564bn ($3.6bn) net loss.

rest.what: King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri after her party finished first on 23 September.
